no_outcome_promised.note: Does not promise a settlement or written terms. It only says the customer will receive an answer. 'Helping you with the next steps' is borderline but does not commit to a settlement.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault or apology conceding liability.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Names a 'Collections & Recoveries team' and describes a handoff and account review that are not in the complaint. The 10-business-day timeframe is acceptable only if it is the standard response timeframe. 'We will add it to your file' also describes a procedure.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems mentioned.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Acknowledges both questions specifically: who to contact, and written settlement terms before payment.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful, and acknowledges the customer's effort without condescension.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode, so ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY restrictions do not apply. The draft takes no position on the substance.

revision_instructions: Remove the reference to the 'Collections & Recoveries team' and the statement that the team will review the account. Replace it with neutral wording, e.g. 'Your message has been passed to the appropriate team, who will respond to your questions.'
Keep the response timeframe only if '10 business days' is the bank's standard response timeframe. Otherwise replace it with the standard timeframe.
Change 'we will add it to your file' to something neutral, e.g. 'please reply to this message.'
Optionally soften 'We look forward to helping you with the next steps' to 'We look forward to responding to your questions,' so it does not imply a settlement will be offered.
